body.name: Rounded proportional two-batch eliminate-one design
body.construction: Given \((T,s,w,\rho)\), allocate the first \(\lfloor\rho T\rceil\) observations by deterministic largest-remainder rounding of \(w\); eliminate the arm \(e\) with the smallest first-batch sample mean using arm-index tie breaking; allocate every remaining observation among \(i\ne e\) by deterministic largest-remainder rounding of \(w_i/(1-w_e)\); deploy the survivor with the largest aggregate sample mean over both batches, again using arm-index tie breaking.
